operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
I hereby create a Board of Inquiry, consisting 
of Honorable Lloyd K. Garrison, Chairman, Honorable James C. 
Hill, and Honorable Arthur Stark as members to inquire into the 
issues involved in such dispute.
The Board shall have powers and duties as set forth in Title I I  
of such Act. The Board shall report to the President in accordance 
with the provisions of Section 206 of such Act on or before June 14, 
1962.
Upon submission of its report, the Board shall continue in existence 
to perform such other functions as may be required under such Act.
